notes.title: Patch 1.05 Notes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Fixed bug that sometimes allowed menu options to be selected when the menu wasn't active.
[*]Fixed bug that allowed players to inadvertently skip certain tutorials before they were shown.
[*]Improved the typewriter tutorial.
[*]Fixed a minor bug when writing using non-Latin characters and diacritic marks.
[*]Fixed a typo, and the punctuation on the propaganda poster is now correct regardless of input.
[*]Ambient volume is generally louder but now dips when the player is writing.
[*]Ambient audio has been added to more objects.
[*]The volume of the phonograph has also been increased.
[*]The developer now has a cold and needs to sleep for a few days.
[/list]
